title: Payday Loans Are a 400% APR Trap — 80% Get Stuck
hook: You borrowed $375 for two weeks — and a year later you've paid over a thousand dollars and still owe money.
angle: Exposes how payday loan mechanics are specifically engineered to create a rollover debt cycle, not provide temporary relief
audience: Anyone living paycheck-to-paycheck, considering a payday loan in an emergency, or unaware of credit union alternatives
key_numbers: 80% of borrowers cannot repay on the due date
12 million Americans use payday loans every year
$521 in fees on the average $375 loan per year
